name: Product Landscape Meta-Model

sourcePin.snapshotRule: Claimed digest over the eleven layer documents; canonical serialization, filename inclusion, README inclusion, encoding and line-ending rules remain unspecified, so the digest is not release evidence.

purpose: Represent a governed time-aware software product landscape, typed cross-product dependencies, explicit completeness and reproducible impact results without copying product identity or internals.

owns: landscape identity and immutable scope versions
impact-query request identity and reproducible result evidence
delegates: software-product identity and lifecycle to the referenced product master
product internals to pinned AISMM product contexts
deployment and runtime facts to their domain masters
capability, process, organization, risk and portfolio identity to external masters
tenant-scoped managed-service semantics to WM-XCT-039 when explicitly referenced
excludes: copies of requirements architecture code deployment or runtime facts
automatic promotion of inferred or scenario edges
compatibility claims based only on equal version labels

Landscape.coverageAuthority: CompletenessStatement is the only authoritative coverage source.

aismmRef.absenceRule: If absent, aismmRefAbsenceReason is mandatory and the membership remains visible but qualified.
aismmRef.rule: The content digest is authoritative. A version label or tag alone never proves compatibility.

productRef.issuingMasterRule: Each scope version declares exactly one issuing product master. Aliases require evidence-backed mappings to the same master record.

LandscapeMembership.overlapRule: Overlapping membership intervals for the same scoped product identity with differing productVersionPin or AISMM digest form one unresolved conflict set; the differing pins never discriminate separate product identities.
LandscapeMembership.unresolvedRule: Unresolved status requires conflictingMembershipRefs and resolutionOwnerRef; contributing assertions remain immutable.

LandscapeDependency.pinStateRule: Pin state is derived per query and never stored on an immutable dependency assertion.
LandscapeDependency.successorRule: A pin-changing successor requires supersedesDependencyId; successor lineage is acyclic.

withdrawalRule.ceased: Included in historical world-time queries within its validity interval.
withdrawalRule.erroneous: Excluded from world-time truth at every instant but retained in the record-time audit trail with retraction evidence.

CompletenessStatement.closureRule: complete requires no known missing sources, no stale sources, unknownBoundary.state=closed-with-evidence with evidence, and every contributing membership and dependency current and pinned.
CompletenessStatement.emptyRule: zero requires an enumerated current complete source set with zero observed edges; every other empty graph is unknown.

ImpactQueryResult.recordTimeRule: Only assertions with recordedAt <= asAt participate. Replaying identical asOf, asAt, graph pins, traversal parameters and entitlement profile reproduces the result.
ImpactQueryResult.accessRule: effectiveAccessCeiling is the strictest contributing access policy. Under existence-suppressed, endpoint identifiers are omitted, suppressedEdgeCount is aggregate-only and coverage cannot be complete.

digestRule.arrayOrder: Sort identifiers and path encodings lexicographically by UTF-8 bytes before canonicalization.
digestRule.comparisonScope: Digests are comparable only within one entitlementProfileId.

pinPolicy.canonicalEdge: Both endpoint product versions and every referenced AISMM context must provide immutable identifier, commit or version, and content digest.
pinPolicy.aismm: No universal AISMM tag is imposed. Each membership pins the exact product-context commit and digest it actually uses; a tag may be recorded as descriptive evidence.
pinPolicy.unresolved: Unpinned or stale references remain visible but are excluded from canonical impact answers.

relations.purpose: Resolve an optional pinned product-internal context without copying it or claiming global compatibility.
Resolve optional tenant-scoped managed-service evidence without importing service or asset mastership; transitive composition remains unverified.

operations.effect: Issue an immutable scope version for one landscape.
Assert temporal participation of one authoritative product version.
operations.authority: landscape steward or delegated product owner

operations.effect: End membership validity through a tombstone while retaining history.
Assert one typed evidenced edge between pinned memberships.
Produce a reproducible result with traversal parameters, exclusions and coverage limits.

invariants: The existing vr.vercy.plmm identifier is reused; 0.1.0-legacy remains byte-identical, immutable and non-installable.
A membership references exactly one namespaced authoritative product identity and never creates a second SoftwareProduct.
Regional deployments, runtime instances and AISMM repositories are not SoftwareProducts.
Product internals are referenced and never copied into PLMM.
Overlapping scoped memberships for one product with differing product or AISMM pins form one unresolved conflict set, never duplicate products.
Every membership and dependency is bound to one immutable scopeVersionId.
A dependency connects scoped memberships and uses the closed evidenced relation vocabulary.
Changing a pin creates an explicit acyclic successor assertion; stored assertions are never retargeted.
Pin state and staleness are query-derived, never stored on the immutable dependency.
Inferred, scenario, unpinned, stale, missing or redacted paths are qualified and never confirmed.
Ceased and erroneous withdrawal have distinct world-time semantics while both remain in the audit trail.
Every result fixes both asOf and asAt and all traversal parameters.
CompletenessStatement is the sole coverage authority and complete has an evidence-backed closure condition.
An empty graph is zero only for a closed current enumerated source set; otherwise it is unknown and never proves no impact.
The evidence digest uses canonical ordered inputs and is entitlement-profile scoped.
Access cannot exceed the strictest contributing policy; suppressed existence removes endpoints and prevents complete coverage.
Capability, process, organization, risk, deployment, service and portfolio identities remain external masters.
AISMM is optional per membership; absence is explicit and qualified, while a label alone never proves compatibility.
WM-XCT-039 is optional reference evidence and never a required base while held.
Retired products, withdrawn edges and erroneous assertions remain audit-resolvable under their respective temporal rules.
The eleven PLMM layers are declared-empty internal bundles of one research candidate and never create catalogue identifiers or structural-completeness claims.
No repository label or local research label reserves or assigns a runtime version.
Publication is refused while fixturesExecuted is false, publishableCanonical is false or any release hold is open.
holds: The single frozen semantic audit returned REVISE; its closed remediation checklist has been applied once without a second audit.
fixturesExecuted is false until executable package conversion supplies and runs bundle, CRUD, role, policy and completeness fixtures.
The PLMM repository organization and historical runtime legacySource provenance remain unreconciled.
Repository v0.1.0 draft and runtime 0.1.0-legacy label mapping remains unresolved.
The claimed source content digest is unverified because a reproducible canonical snapshot procedure is absent.
AISMM runtime-digest-to-repository-commit compatibility remains unproven; the frozen tree is four commits past tag v3.1.0.
The earlier AISMM 3.2 README question is closed as evidence-absent; no 3.2 string exists in the frozen dossier.
The PLMM-AISMM semantic crosswalk, rights/licensing and source mastership remain unverified.
ELMM is named in a blocking decision but absent from the dossier, so its role remains unresolved.
WM-SFT-001 and AISMM product identity crosswalk remains dependent on EM-TEC-01 and outside this dossier.
WM-XCT-039 remains optional and held; its vr.wm-xct-001/003/037 transitive composition targets are outside this dossier.
Installability and publication require registry allocation of a version plus runtime, search, resolve, package and live verification.

providerReconciliation.resolvedDecision: Complete the existing reserved vr.vercy.plmm model; preserve 0.1.0-legacy byte-identical and non-installable; create no new model or runtime identifier and no second SoftwareProduct.
decisionNotes: Membership identity excludes AISMM digest so pin disagreement becomes a conflict instead of a duplicate product.
AISMM is optional per membership with an explicit absence reason; no universal required registry coordinate is claimed.
Per-membership exact AISMM pins and access-ceiling semantics are local reconciliation decisions, not attributed to either provider.

temporalPolicy.asOf: World-time instant evaluated by the query.
temporalPolicy.asAt: Record-time cutoff; only assertions recorded no later than this instant participate.
temporalPolicy.interval: Validity intervals are half-open [validFrom, validTo); absent validTo means open-ended.
temporalPolicy.pinEvolution: A changed endpoint content digest creates a successor assertion with an explicit predecessor reference. Prior assertions are never retargeted or overwritten.
temporalPolicy.staleness: Staleness is derived in a query result relative to asOf and never stored on the dependency.

completenessContract.completeRule: complete requires no known missing sources, no stale sources, unknownBoundary.state=closed-with-evidence with evidence, and every contributing membership and dependency current and pinned.
completenessContract.zeroRule: zero requires an enumerated current complete source set with zero observed edges; every other empty graph is unknown.
completenessContract.confirmedRule: Only declared or observed paths whose scoped memberships, endpoint pins, authority and visible evidence are complete and current may be confirmed.
completenessContract.qualifiedRule: Unpinned, stale, missing, inferred, scenario and access-redacted assertions remain qualified with machine-readable reasons.

migration.rule: Preserve the legacy release byte-identical and non-installable. No instance migration exists because the legacy structure is empty.
migration.successor: Consumers receive an explicit successor pointer and opt in to a separately versioned draft after bundles, CRUD, roles, policies and fixtures are complete.
migration.versionGuard: No repository label assigns a runtime version. The actual repository v0.1.0 draft label is evidence only.

entryKindProvenance: candidate-only proposed registry value pending registry control
statusProvenance: candidate-only lifecycle value; not a registry release claim
researchVersionNotice: 0.2.0-candidate.3 is a local research label and reserves no runtime version.

legacyLabelMapping.requiredEvidence: A registry-controlled mapping assertion that pins repository commit and runtime digest.

relationVocabularyEvidence: Pinned PLMM layer 02 at sourcePin.commit; closed until registry-controlled extension.

roleDefinitions.landscape-steward: May issue scopes and assertions under a declared mandate.
roleDefinitions.delegated-product-owner: May assert membership only for product identities within the mandate.
roleDefinitions.relationship-owner: May assert one relation whose authorityRef resolves to the mandate.
roleDefinitions.authorized-reader: May query only for a purpose allowed by accessPolicyRef and entitlementProfileId.
